title: Excellent tour of the Sevilla culture and history
text: Sofia was an absolutely fantastic tour guide whose in depth explanation of each cultural and historical site we visited really allowed us to explore and discover the beauty of Sevilla. She paced the tour in a way that allowed us to really explore, learn and enjoy the experience. My wife and I have taken many private tours over the years and I must say this one was one of the best we have done. We will definitely remember this tour as one of our fondest memories of Spain.
author: John W

title: Seville, a wonderful city
text:
Sofia showed us the city with its monuments, history and architectural beauty.
Seville, a city to visit again, and certainly with Sofia as your guide.

title: Great private tour
text:
We had a great time on our tour with Sofia.  She was very accessible and helpful before our trip by email and gave us recommendations for restaurants and other activities.  The tour was fantastic and Sofia was a perfect guide.  She has a wealth of knowledge and her language skills are excellent.
I would highly recommend Sofia if you are planning on a private tour of Seville.
